spatial_exclusion_buffer_policy.justification: Per ADR-011 (Adr011Thresholds.leakage_belt_km = 10.0, DonorSpec.leakage_belt_km = 10.0) and Verra VM0009 / VCS AFOLU leakage-belt conventions, a 10 km outward buffer around the project boundary screens out immediate local activity-shifting and edge spillover zones. Districts that directly overlap the project boundary (distance = 0.0 km) or lie within 10.0 km of the project boundary are excluded. Geographic adjacency to a host district outside the 10 km project buffer is recorded as a diagnostic warning rather than treated as automatic proof of contamination; conversely, non-adjacency does not guarantee SUTVA.
